subject: german
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in German on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (German↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I spend too much time online'?
options: Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online
Ich verbringe zu viel Geld online
questions.explain: 'Zeit verbringen' = 'to spend time' and 'zu viel' = 'too much', so this means 'I spend too much time online'.
'Eine Sendung' is a TV/radio programme (from 'senden', to broadcast).

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I follow many influencers online'?
questions.explain: 'Folgen' takes the dative, so 'Ich folge vielen Influencern online' (present tense) = 'I follow many influencers online'.
'Die Nachrichten' means 'the news' (TV/radio); singular 'eine Nachricht' = a message.
'Lust haben' means 'to fancy/feel like' doing something, e.g. 'Hast du Lust ins Kino zu gehen?'.
'Herunterladen' means 'to download' (literally 'to load down'). 'Hochladen' is 'to upload'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I prefer to watch series on my phone'?
options: Ich sehe Serien lieber auf dem Handy
Ich sehe Serien lieber im Kino
Ich höre Serien lieber auf dem Handy
Ich sehe Filme lieber auf dem Handy

questions.explain: 'Der Bildschirm' means 'the screen'. ('Der Schirm' alone can mean umbrella — a near-miss.)
'Die sozialen Medien' means 'social media' (also 'soziale Netzwerke' = social networks).
'Ein Sänger' is a male singer (female: 'eine Sängerin'); 'a song' is 'ein Lied'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I go swimming twice a week'?
options: Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe einmal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche tanzen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Monat schwimmen
questions.explain: 'Zweimal pro Woche' = 'twice a week' and 'schwimmen' = 'to swim'.
'Berühmt' means 'famous', e.g. 'Er ist berühmt für seine Musik' = 'He is famous for his music'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich lese normalerweise abends' mean?
options: I have to read in the evenings
I used to read in the evenings
I usually read in the evenings
I will read in the evenings
questions.explain: 'Normalerweise' means 'usually' and 'abends' = 'in the evenings', so this is 'I usually read in the evenings'.
